notes.title: Demo Version 0.2 Update
notes.content:
Fixed bugs and made minor changes based on the received feedback. Further adjustments received through the feedback form and related to improving the gameplay will be implemented in future updates.

Fixed an issue with automatic language detection based on the system language

Fixed a bug where all tavern visitors would leave after refusing the goblin's takeaway order

Fixed a crash that occurred for some users

Expanded the inventory
